item.title: New Middle School Principal Named in Hastings
item.description: By Rick Pezzullo— The Hastings-on-Hudson Board of Education recently unanimously appointed Ms. Lina M. Carolini-Cannavò as principal of Farragut Middle School, effective July 1, 2026. item.title: Mr. Lawler: Cordiality Isn't Enough
item.description: To: The Editor, The Hudson Independent: I recently wrote to our Member of Congress, Mike Lawler, in opposition to the so-called Save America Act, a blatant attempt to disenfranchise whole groups of voters by requiring a birth certificate or passport in order to register to vote. Mr. Lawler’s response was quite cordial, but it failed to address the difficulties the proposed law would present to those without a passport or whose birth certificate does not reflect a person’s married name. item.title: Irvington, Sleepy Hollow Heads of the Class Named
item.description: By Rick Pezzullo— The Class of 2026 valedictorian and salutatorian at Irvington and Sleepy Hollow high schools were recently named.
